messages:
Priya (IC): :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall @Alex — alert: high 5xx/latency for hosted API in us-west-2 affecting generation and embeddings. Metrics show spike at 1745255980. Can you confirm?

incident-bot: Alert triggered: api.hosted.prod.us-west-2 > 5xx-rate > 3% for 5m. Pager: @Alex. Incident ID: INC-20250321-01

Alex (Oncall SRE): On it. I'm looking at autoscaler and pod logs. Assigning to myself as responder. ETA 2m.

Priya (IC): Thanks. Support folks, please prepare customer-facing wording & macros. Suggest we draft: (1) status page blurb, (2) Zendesk macro, (3) Intercom canned reply + troubleshooting checklist for agents.

Mark (Support Lead): Copy. I'll own the macros. Drafting now — will post below, tell me edits. Jules, please stand by to use them.

Jules (Support Agent): Ready. Need the exact status page text to link in tickets.

Liam (SRE): Quick notes: increased tail latency due to failed GPU node pool scale-up; we're seeing retry storms from some clients. Mitigations: temporarily route to eu-west for low-latency customers, and scale down optimizer to reduce queueing. Alex please confirm.

Alex (Oncall SRE): Confirmed. Killed flapping pod, increased replica count on fallback pool, enabled emergency routing rule. Observability: 502s dropping from 3.8% -> 1.2% (ongoing). I'll keep monitoring.

Priya (IC): Good. Mark, here's a first-pass status page update. Keep it short and clear:

---
Status page (short blurb):
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased request latency for the Redwood Hosted API in us-west-2. Affected features: text generation and embeddings. Engineers are actively mitigating; routing to fallback capacity and scaling actions are in progress. Some customers may experience errors or delays. ETA for next update: 30 minutes.
---

Mark (Support Lead): Proposed Zendesk macro (please review tone):

MACRO: Incident — US-WEST-2 API 5xxs (INC-20250321-01)
Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},

Thanks for reporting this. We're currently investigating elevated errors and increased latency for the Redwood Hosted API in us-west-2. Our engineering team is actively responding and we have routing mitigations in place to reduce impact. Some requests may still fail or be delayed briefly.

What we're doing:
• Routing traffic to fallback capacity in another region
• Scaling affected pools and removing flapping nodes
• Monitoring for request success rate and latency

What you can expect:
• Short-term errors or delays for in-flight requests
• No action required on your side — we will update you when the incident is resolved or if we need more info

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20250321-01

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your workflows and we're prioritizing a fix.

Best,
Redwood Support

Mark (Support Lead): Intercom canned reply (short):
Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for the message — we're aware of elevated errors in us-west-2 and actively working on mitigation. You can follow updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20250321-01. We'll keep you posted.

Jules (Support Agent): These look good. Two quick suggestions: add a line to Zendesk macro about token safety (customers worried about retries/duplicates) and include expected retry behavior.

Mark (Support Lead): Good call. Patch in:
• Note: retries are idempotent for most generation calls; please avoid resubmitting large batches until we confirm stability.

Tanya (Customer Success): Can we add an internal broadcast wording for Slack #general and an executive summary for CSMs to send to large customers?

Priya (IC): Yes. Internal short alert for #general (non-technical):

Internal Slack broadcast (public):
Heads-up: We're currently investigating intermittent errors and delays affecting our Hosted API in us-west-2. Engineers are working on mitigations. We will post updates to the status page. If customers ask, direct them to the status page link and escalate to Support if the customer is high-touch.

Priya (IC): Exec/CSM template (private):
Hi [CustomerName],
We're currently experiencing elevated errors affecting the Hosted API in us-west-2. Our engineers have implemented routing to fallback capacity and are actively stabilizing services. We will follow up with timelines and impacts specific to your footprint — if you'd like an immediate impact assessment, please share your project IDs and traffic windows and we'll prioritize.

Liam (SRE): For support agents — here's a short troubleshooting checklist you can run (do not escalate to SRE unless step 4 fails):
1) Confirm customer's region (us-west-2?) and timestamp of error
2) Check live status page link for current advisory
3) Ask if the request was retried/duplicated by client and advise to pause bulk retries
4) Check request id if available and search logs (internal tool) for 502/timeout at timestamp
5) If customer reports persistent failures after 20m or has paid SLA, escalate to @Support Lead and include ticket + sample request id

Jules (Support Agent): I'll add a quick copy-paste for the Zendesk private note with log search command:

```
# Internal: search logs for request_id
logs query: service:api AND region:us-west-2 AND request_id:"{{custom_field.request_id}}" | sort timestamp desc | limit 50
```

Mark (Support Lead): Final check on tone — remove apologetic repetition, keep concise. Anyone object to final Zendesk macro being published? If not, I'll push the macro to the support macro library and update the ticket templates.

Alex (Oncall SRE): No objections. Monitoring shows 5xxs down to 0.6% and P95 latency improving. Keeping the routing active for another 20m then we'll test rollback.

Priya (IC): Great work. Action items:
- Mark: publish Zendesk & Intercom macros + update support runbook (assigned)
- Jules: use macro on incoming tickets, add internal notes if you see request_ids (assigned)
- Alex/Liam: monitor and post final incident resolution when stable (assigned)
- Tanya: prepare CSM outreach list for customers above X usage

incident-bot: Incident INC-20250321-01 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update scheduled 1745257660.

Priya (IC): Closing loop — once resolved, please add post-incident summary to #postmortems and include timeline + customer impact estimates.

Jules (Support Agent): Understood. I'll file the tickets with macro and add notes.

Mark (Support Lead): Published macros and added status page link to template. Thanks everyone.

Priya (IC): :thumbsup: Thanks team — great coordination.
